name: qomplement
long_description:
qomplement is the agentic ERP for retail and logistics companies.

Retail and logistics are the industries with the highest volume of transactions in the world. POs, freight invoices, inventory updates, and shipment confirmations. Every single one still requires a person to process it manually. Their only solution has been hiring more people.

Legacy ERPs were built for humans. qomplement is the agentic ERP that cuts 95% of manual work and handles 100x more transactions with the same headcount. We give procurement and operations teams superpowers: automating purchase order intake, vendor onboarding, item master updates, freight order processing, carrier invoicing, three-way matching, and inventory reconciliation.

Headquartered in San Francisco.
one_liner: The Agentic ERP for supply chain operations

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Kerim and Andres met in college studying computer science. They became friends trying to track a jaguar near their city. They placed cameras across the mountains, collected more than 15,000 minutes of footage, and quickly realized there was no way to review it all manually. That was their first real problem to solve with AI.

They spent the next few years building AI systems together at their university's research lab.

qomplement started with a phone call. One of the largest oil and gas companies in the world reached out with a problem that seemed almost too simple: they had more than 30 people whose entire job was moving data between systems all day.\
Kerim and Andres flew out immediately. They rented an apartment next to the client's office and spent a full month doing the work themselves. Every purchase order, every ERP update, every vendor portal, every email. They wanted to feel the problem before building anything.

That month became the foundation for qomplement.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
The global economy is roughly $100 trillion. Around $30 trillion of that is the physical economy, the movement of goods across retail, logistics, and supply chains. Yet this entire part of the economy still runs on legacy ERPs, spreadsheets, and large operations teams.

The problem is that these businesses scale by adding headcount. Every new PO, every invoice, every shipment confirmation requires a human to process manually. As headcount grows, human error compounds, processes slow down, and operations become a bottleneck to growth.

We discovered this firsthand. We flew out to one of the largest oil and gas companies in the world, rented an apartment next to their office, and spent a month doing the work ourselves. Every PO, every ERP update, every vendor email. 30 people whose entire job was moving data between systems all day. That month became the foundation for qomplement.

\
**What we're building**

qomplement is the agentic ERP for retail and logistics companies. We replace NetSuite and SAP with an AI-native system where agents handle the full workflow end to end, procurement, inventory, freight, and finance, without human input.\
We land with one high-pain module, prove value in weeks, and expand until we replace the entire ERP. Full migrations take 2 months instead of 12. Same team, 100x more transactions.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
SAP and NetSuite have dominated enterprise software for 30 years. Every company moving physical goods has built entire departments just to keep those systems running.

We're on a mission to end that. A world where no one hates their ERP. Where one person processes what used to take entire departments. Where the system does the work instead of just recording it.

qomplement is the agentic ERP replacing Oracle and NetSuite, built from the ground up for AI agents, not humans.

launches.tagline: Process 100x more transactions without hiring anyone.
launches.body:
Hey YC! We are [Kerim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kerim-taray/) and [Andres](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andres-fernando-garza/) from [qomplement](https://www.qomplement.com/).

**TDLR;** Retail and logistics are the industries with the highest volume of transactions in the world. POs, freight invoices, inventory updates, and shipment confirmations. Their only solution has been hiring more people. qomplement is the agentic ERP that cuts 95% of manual work and handles 100x more transactions with the same headcount.

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/JmxZsu44XUM?si=OQ-cJZbmyUFplQ3m>

**The problem**

The global economy is $100 trillion. 30% of that moves through supply chain industries. Every transaction still requires a human to process. These companies scale by hiring people. As headcount grows, errors compound, processes slow down, and operations become the bottleneck to growth.\
Every AI-native ERP built today went after software companies and finance teams. But in retail and logistics, 80% of complexity is operations, not finance. These industries are underserved.

**The solution**

qomplement is the AI-native ERP for supply chain, cutting 95% of manual work and processing 100x more transactions with zero new hires.

The reason we're winning is deployment speed. SAP and NetSuite take a year to implement. We go live in 2 months. We're on a mission to be the best deployment company in the world.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103369&key=user_uploads/3422927/b740633e-04d3-4b98-a483-cd09eced7515)

**Team**

Kerim and Andres graduated top of their CS class and have worked together for 4+ years out of their university's AI research lab. Their first company hit $1M ARR in college.\
They became friends trying to track a jaguar across the mountains. They placed cameras, collected 15,000 minutes of footage, and quickly realized there was no way to review it all manually. That's how they got into AI.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103369&key=user_uploads/3422927/9cb2cabb-b9f2-4e28-a08b-d21cc7d3e479)

[kerim@qomplement.com](mailto:kerim@qomplement.com) / [hello@qomplement.com](mailto:hello@qomplement.com)

**Our ask**

If you're a COO, VP of Operations, or CFO at a retail or logistics company, we can deploy a PoC in hours. If you know anyone, we'd love an intro.
